versions.subject: Rule: Suspicious PowerShell parent image combination
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage:
        - '*\wscript.exe'
        - '*\cscript.exe'
    Image:
        - '*\powershell.exe'
condition: selection

versions.subject: Fixed parse errors
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage:
        - '*\wscript.exe'
        - '*\cscript.exe'
    Image:
        - '*\powershell.exe'
falsepositive:
    CurrentDirectory: '*\Health Service State\*'
condition: selection and not falsepositive
versions.spl: EventID=1 ParentImage IN ("*\\wscript.exe", "*\\cscript.exe") Image="*\\powershell.exe" NOT CurrentDirectory="*\\Health Service State\*"
